name: Flat dirt pad past the white gate, above the canyon (rough dirt road)
basis: MP The Promised Land 'Getting There': Perkinsville Rd to Hidden Ranch Rd, left fork to a white gate, then 'park in the flat dirt pad, and walk down the canyon to get to the routes'; Explore Prescott-type guides say main climbing is 10-15 min from the parking. Only one mapped lot exists in the brief, ~0.9 km from the crag centre; match is by position, not by an exact coordinate in the text.
